How to make a Spotify QR code

Every item in Spotify has a share link, and that link is all this tool needs.

  1. In Spotify, open the song, playlist, album, artist or podcast episode.
  2. Use the three-dot menu, then Share, then Copy link.
  3. Paste the link into the field above.
  4. Style the code with your colors, and add a logo if you like.
  5. Download the PNG or SVG and test that it opens Spotify on a phone.

Spotify also has its own scannable Spotify Codes. Use a standard QR code when you want any phone camera to read it, or when you want your own colors and logo.

Tips for music and podcast codes

A code is only useful if the link works for everyone.

  • Make playlists public if you want anyone to open them. Private playlists will not open for others.
  • Listeners need Spotify or the web player. People without the app can still open the web version, though some content may need an account.
  • Check regional availability. Some tracks are not available in every country.
  • Use a short, clear call to action, like "Scan for the playlist".
  • Size: at least about 1 inch (2.5 cm) on cards and sleeves.
